def _make_pending_order(event, expires, **kwargs):
    return Order.objects.create(
        code='FOO', event=event, email='dummy@dummy.test',
        status=Order.STATUS_PENDING,
        datetime=now() - timedelta(days=10), expires=expires,
        total=Decimal('23.00'), locale='en',
        sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
        **kwargs
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_expires_overdue_pending_order(event):
    o = _make_pending_order(event, now() - timedelta(days=1))
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED
    assert o.all_logentries().filter(action_type='pretix.event.order.expired').exists()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_keeps_order_with_future_deadline(event):
    o = _make_pending_order(event, now() + timedelta(days=1))
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_ignores_non_pending_orders(event):
    paid = _make_pending_order(event, now() - timedelta(days=1))
    paid.status = Order.STATUS_PAID
    paid.save()
    expired = _make_pending_order(event, now() - timedelta(days=2), code='BAR')
    expired.status = Order.STATUS_EXPIRED
    expired.save()
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    paid.refresh_from_db()
    expired.refresh_from_db()
    assert paid.status == Order.STATUS_PAID
    assert expired.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_ignores_orders_requiring_approval(event):
    o = _make_pending_order(event, now() - timedelta(days=1), require_approval=True)
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_ignores_valid_if_pending_orders(event):
    o = _make_pending_order(event, now() - timedelta(days=1), valid_if_pending=True)
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_respects_disabled_automatic_expiry(event):
    event.settings.payment_term_expire_automatically = False
    o = _make_pending_order(event, now() - timedelta(days=1))
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_respects_payment_term_expire_delay(event):
    event.settings.payment_term_expire_delay_days = 5
    recent = _make_pending_order(event, now() - timedelta(days=1))
    overdue = _make_pending_order(event, now() - timedelta(days=6), code='BAR')
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    recent.refresh_from_db()
    overdue.refresh_from_db()
    assert recent.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING
    assert overdue.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_only_affects_events_with_automatic_expiry(event):
    other_event = Event.objects.create(
        organizer=event.organizer, name='Other', slug='other',
        date_from=now(), plugins='pretix.plugins.banktransfer',
    )
    other_event.settings.payment_term_expire_automatically = False
    o1 = _make_pending_order(event, now() - timedelta(days=1))
    o2 = _make_pending_order(other_event, now() - timedelta(days=1), code='BAR')
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    o1.refresh_from_db()
    o2.refresh_from_db()
    assert o1.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED
    assert o2.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING
EOF
